# Antigravity Cua Computer Use (`cua-computer-use`)

[English](README.en.md) | 简体中文

面向 **Google Antigravity（Windows）** 的本地原生桌面真后台 GUI 自动化插件，基于开源 [`cua-driver`](https://github.com/trycua/cua)（UI Automation 语义树 + Windows Graphics Capture 后台截屏）封装，可在 `Settings > Plugins` 一键启停，不影响其他 AI 客户端或全局 `mcp_config.json`。

> 本项目为独立社区整合插件，与 Cua AI, Inc. 及 Google 无官方隶属关系。

## 为什么做这个插件

直接把裸 `cua-driver mcp` 写入全局配置在 Antigravity Windows 端存在 5 个常见痛点，本插件一次性收口：

1. **修复 NTFS Junction 技能静默失效**：`cua-driver skills install` 在 Windows 创建目录联接（Junction），Antigravity 定制扫描器会跳过重解析点。本插件全部以实体文件部署 `skills/cua-driver/`。
2. **服务端硬裁剪 62 → 39 个纯原生工具**：`scripts/mcp_filter_proxy.py` 在 MCP 服务端侧移除全部 13 个浏览器冲突工具（避免与 Antigravity 内置 `browser` 子代理抢活）、废弃 `replay_trajectory` 及 `kill_app`/`set_config`/`install_ffmpeg`/录屏等高危低频项，并在 `tools/call` 层返回 `-32601` 硬拦截，同时净化 `initialize` 引导语。
3. **复用 High-IL 后台守护进程 + 自动自愈**：自动探测 `\\.\pipe\cua-driver`，守护未启动时自动执行 `cua-driver autostart kick` 拉起高权限管道（穿透 Win11 UWP/AppContainer UIA 树），不可用时平滑降级直连 `cua-driver mcp`。
4. **真后台防抢焦点护栏与高效批处理**：注入 `rules/AGENTS.md` 与优化后的 `skills/cua-driver/SKILL.md`，强制接口优先、默认 `delivery_mode: "background"`（遇 `background_unavailable` 须经用户授权才可升格 `foreground`）、优先 `run_steps` 与 QuickJS `run_script` 本地树筛选以压缩往返。
5. **零遥测兜底**：代理进程默认注入 `CUA_DRIVER_RS_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=0` 与 `CUA_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=0`，安装脚本同步执行 `cua-driver telemetry disable` 与 `reset-id`。

## 前置条件

- **Windows 10 (1903+) / Windows 11 x64**（已解锁交互桌面）
- **Python 3.10+**
- **`cua-driver`（推荐 `0.53.0+`）**：
  ```powershell
  irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex
  cua-driver telemetry disable
  cua-driver telemetry reset-id
  cua-driver status
  ```

## 快速安装

### 方式 A：直接克隆（Python 已在 `PATH` 时开箱即用）

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/bartholo4/antigravity-cua-computer-use.git "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\cua-computer-use"
```

### 方式 B：通过安装脚本部署（自动绑定本机 Python 路径并关闭遥测）

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/bartholo4/antigravity-cua-computer-use.git
cd antigravity-cua-computer-use
.\install.ps1
```

如果 Python 不在 `PATH` 中，可显式指定解释器：

```powershell
.\install.ps1 -PythonExe "C:\Path\to\python.exe"
```

安装完成后重启 Antigravity（或在 **Settings > Plugins** 刷新/启用 **Cua Computer Use (Windows GUI)**）。

## 仓库结构

```text
.
├── plugin.json                 # Antigravity 插件清单
├── mcp_config.json             # 便携式 MCP 启动配置（零个人路径）
├── install.ps1                 # Windows 实体文件安装脚本
├── assets/logo.svg             # 插件图标
├── rules/AGENTS.md             # 路由与真后台安全护栏
├── scripts/mcp_filter_proxy.py # 39 工具白名单过滤 + 守护自愈 stdio 代理
├── skills/cua-driver/          # Windows 操控技能与参考文档
│   ├── SKILL.md                # 精简入口（含 QuickJS run_script 本地树筛选范式）
│   ├── WINDOWS.md              # Windows delivery_mode、UWP/AUMID 详情
│   ├── WORKFLOW.md             # 观察、批处理、run_script、校验规约
│   ├── RUNTIME.md              # 管道架构、会话与权限
│   └── VISUAL.md               # 可选 cua-perception 说明（默认用 zoom）
└── tests/test_proxy.py         # 零依赖单元与端到端代理测试
```

## 39 个白名单核心工具

| 类别 | 工具（共 39 个） |
|---|---|
| 诊断与指南（4） | `health_report`, `check_permissions`, `get_config`, `get_guide` |
| 应用与窗口（6） | `list_apps`, `list_windows`, `launch_app`, `bring_to_front`, `set_window_frame`, `debug_window_info` |
| 观测与校验（7） | `get_window_state`, `get_accessibility_tree`, `get_desktop_state`, `get_screen_size`, `parse_visual_regions`, `zoom`, `verify_state` |
| 动作与批处理（12） | `run_steps`, `run_script`, `click`, `double_click`, `right_click`, `drag`, `scroll`, `type_text`, `press_key`, `hotkey`, `set_value`, `invoke_menu` |
| 剪贴板（2） | `clipboard_read`, `clipboard_write` |
| 会话与光标（8） | `start_session`, `get_session`, `list_sessions`, `end_session`, `get_cursor_position`, `move_cursor`, `get_agent_cursor_state`, `set_agent_cursor_enabled` |

## 日常免 UAC 升级 `cua-driver`

当本机已注册高权限开机自启计划任务（`\cua-driver-serve`）时，可免弹 UAC 热升级底层驱动：

```powershell
$installer = "$env:TEMP\cua-install.ps1"
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1" -OutFile $installer -UseBasicParsing
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $installer -NoAutoStart -NoConnect -NoTest
cua-driver stop
cua-driver autostart kick
cua-driver status
```

## 运行测试

```bash
python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py" -v
```

## 许可与致谢

- 本插件代码与配置以 [MIT License](LICENSE) 发布。
- `skills/cua-driver/{WINDOWS,WORKFLOW,RUNTIME,VISUAL}.md` 源自开源项目 [`trycua/cua`](https://github.com/trycua/cua)（MIT License），详见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

# Antigravity Cua Computer Use (`cua-computer-use`)

English | [简体中文](README.md)

A local Windows background GUI automation plugin for **Google Antigravity**, built on top of open-source [`cua-driver`](https://github.com/trycua/cua) (UI Automation accessibility trees + Windows Graphics Capture). Toggle it directly in **Settings > Plugins** without touching global `mcp_config.json` or other AI clients.

> Independent community integration plugin; not affiliated with or endorsed by Cua AI, Inc. or Google.

## Why This Plugin

Wiring raw `cua-driver mcp` into global config on Windows causes several sharp edges in Antigravity. This plugin addresses all five cleanly:

1. **Fixes silent NTFS Junction skill skipping**: `cua-driver skills install` links skills via Windows Junctions, which Antigravity's customization scanner skips. This plugin ships real files under `skills/cua-driver/`.
2. **Server-side 62 → 39 native-only allowlist**: `scripts/mcp_filter_proxy.py` strips 13 browser-conflicting tools (preventing overlap with Antigravity's built-in `browser` subagent), deprecated `replay_trajectory`, and high-risk/noisy tools (`kill_app`, `set_config`, `install_ffmpeg`, recording/theme tools), rejecting excluded `tools/call` requests with JSON-RPC `-32601` and sanitizing `initialize` instructions.
3. **High-IL named-pipe auto-healing**: checks `\\.\pipe\cua-driver` before launch, runs `cua-driver autostart kick` if stopped (preserving High-IL UWP/AppContainer UIA visibility), and gracefully falls back to direct `cua-driver mcp`.
4. **True background guardrails & low-roundtrip batching**: bundles `rules/AGENTS.md` and an enhanced `skills/cua-driver/SKILL.md` enforcing API/CLI-first routing, strict `delivery_mode: "background"` default (requiring user authorization before `foreground` escalation), `run_steps` batching, and QuickJS `run_script` local UIA tree filtering.
5. **Telemetry disabled by default**: injects `CUA_DRIVER_RS_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=0` and `CUA_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=0`, with `install.ps1` running `cua-driver telemetry disable` and `reset-id`.

## Prerequisites

- **Windows 10 (1903+) / Windows 11 x64** (unlocked interactive desktop)
- **Python 3.10+**
- **`cua-driver` (`0.53.0+` recommended)**:
  ```powershell
  irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex
  cua-driver telemetry disable
  cua-driver telemetry reset-id
  cua-driver status
  ```

## Quick Install

### Option A: Direct Clone (works out-of-the-box when `python` is on `PATH`)

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/bartholo4/antigravity-cua-computer-use.git "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\cua-computer-use"
```

### Option B: Installer Script (resolves exact Python path & disables telemetry)

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/bartholo4/antigravity-cua-computer-use.git
cd antigravity-cua-computer-use
.\install.ps1
```

If Python is not on `PATH`:

```powershell
.\install.ps1 -PythonExe "C:\Path\to\python.exe"
```

Then restart Antigravity (or enable **Cua Computer Use (Windows GUI)** in **Settings > Plugins**).

## Zero-UAC `cua-driver` Upgrade (with existing High-IL autostart task)

```powershell
$installer = "$env:TEMP\cua-install.ps1"
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1" -OutFile $installer -UseBasicParsing
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $installer -NoAutoStart -NoConnect -NoTest
cua-driver stop
cua-driver autostart kick
cua-driver status
```

## Running Tests

```bash
python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py" -v
```

- Bundled upstream reference guides (`skills/cua-driver/{WINDOWS,WORKFLOW,RUNTIME,VISUAL}.md`): MIT License from [`trycua/cua`](https://github.com/trycua/cua). See [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
